source.note: Assumption, unverified for the bands and the usual ranges; the schema has one evidence field per template, so slotEvidence and usual.evidence stay assumption although the nominal ratio was read. Read: classic 2 oz rum, 3/4 oz lime juice, 3/4 oz simple syrup; root recipe 2 oz rum (1 3/4 + 1/4), 1 oz lime juice, 3/4 oz simple syrup. The nominal spec (60 : 22.5 : 22.5 ml) is the classic recipe; the root's 1 oz of lime (1.0 parts) lies inside the band. The book files Collins, Mule, Mojito, French 75, Whiskey Sour, Southside and Mai Tai under this template; the optional slots after the sweet slot are chosen here and no ratio of those drinks was read. The lower edge of the sweet slot (0.25) is Embury's 1 part sweet to 8 parts base as cited on Wikipedia (secondary). See docs/templates.md#evidence.
